name: Regen Eliza: The Autonomous Omni-Agent
description: Regen Eliza is an Autonomous Omni-Agent serving as a bridge between human intent and Web3 regenerative economies. We utilize an internal JSON registry to dynamically route micro-donations to verified eco-projects and builders. Our voice-controlled UI allows humans to execute on-chain transactions and trigger DeFi token swaps without interacting with complex dApp interfaces, while showcasing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) hiring intents.
problemStatement: Funding public goods requires manual evaluation and high friction. Regen Eliza solves this by dynamically routing capital, demonstrating automated swapping via Uniswap, and bridging value to Celo for high-frequency micro-donations.

submissionMetadata.agentFrameworkOther: Custom Next.js Server Actions + ERC-8004 Architecture
submissionMetadata.intentionNotes: INCIDENT RESPONSE NARRATIVE: Regen Eliza is an Omni-Agent. During development, our Base Node (ID 30121) wallet was compromised by a live MEV sweeper bot. Security protocols were immediately initiated, and active demonstration and custody were migrated seamlessly to our Celo Node (Agent 1851) at a secure address (0xC57f7ce71FDe55CEE70f509a9B441Db87Be07D60). The Celo Node holds our official, verified hackathon metadata.
